seo.title: About — LifeLoom
seo.description: About LifeLoom, an independent software brand creating focused apps for everyday life.

hero.heading: A home for focused, independent software.
hero.description: LifeLoom is an independent software brand creating apps across competition, productivity and everyday experiences.

principles.title: Start with the problem
principles.description: Products begin with a real reason to exist, not a need to fill a feature list.

principles.title: Design with restraint
principles.description: Interfaces should make the product easier to use, not compete for attention.

principles.title: Improve continuously
principles.description: Apps are treated as living products that can become more useful over time.

productsStrip.heading: Different apps. One standard.
productsStrip.description: Every LifeLoom app can have its own visual identity while sharing the same approach to clarity, reliability and thoughtful software.
